_meta.description: 材质破坏词库：不同材质遵循固有的物理碎裂逻辑，动作威力由破坏效果反向衬托
_meta.usage: 严禁写模糊的 'everything is destroyed'，必须写出具体的碎片元素

material_types.name: 石材与水泥
material_types.physics: 极度的刚性和脆性。受巨力时不会弯曲，而是瞬间粉碎或大块龟裂
visualElements: 蜘蛛网状的裂纹向四周蔓延
大块的不规则碎石飞溅
极其浓重的粉尘（Dust Cloud）爆出
prompts: concrete pillar explodes into jagged chunks, massive spiderweb cracks spreading across the ground, thick cloud of grey dust billowing outwards
stone floor shattering with radiating cracks, heavy rubble and debris flying, dense dust cloud erupting from impact point
granite wall crumbling, irregular stone fragments tumbling outward, blinding cloud of pulverized concrete

material_types.name: 木材与树木
material_types.physics: 纤维结构。受击时必须是折断、劈裂和撕裂
visualElements: 断裂处呈参差不齐的纤维状（而非平滑切口）
prompts: wooden door shatters violently, hundreds of sharp wooden splinters flying through the air, jagged broken timber edges, tearing wood
wooden pillar snapped in half with splintering fracture, wood fibers visible at the break point, sharp debris spinning outward
ancient wooden table smashed apart, jagged splinters and wood shards scattering, grain of the wood visible at fracture points

material_types.name: 玻璃与晶体
visualElements: 成千上万带反光的碎片（Shards）在半空中慢动作飞舞
prompts: glass window shatters instantly in a starburst pattern, thousands of glittering shards suspended in mid-air reflecting light, slow-motion glass explosion
crystalline barrier exploding into prismatic shards, rainbow light refracting through flying glass fragments, sparkles cascading downward
massive glass wall detonating outward, reflective shards catching light from every angle, crystal rain suspended in time

material_types.name: 金属与装甲
material_types.physics: 延展性和韧性。受击时先凹陷（Denting），后撕裂（Tearing）
visualElements: 金属摩擦爆出的橘红色火花（Sparks）
prompts: thick steel armor severely dented inward, screeching metal tearing open, shower of bright orange sparks erupting from the impact point, glowing red edges
metal shield buckling under force, deep dent with radiating stress fractures, shower of orange sparks and molten droplets
iron door torn open with jagged metal edges, glowing hot where the metal was sheared, sparks cascading down

collapse_phases.description: 巨型崩塌的延迟与重力感——严禁瞬间消失

phases.name: 受击
phases.description: 剧震、局部爆炸、大量粉尘喷出
prompts: massive shockwave with dust eruption
structural cracking with debris shower

phases.name: 倾斜与断裂
phases.description: 主体开始缓慢倾斜，内部结构发出令人牙酸的折断声
prompts: slow lean with interior groaning and cracking sounds
stress fractures spreading before collapse

phases.name: 轰然倒塌
phases.description: 带着巨大的质量感砸向地面，掀起遮天蔽日的尘土墙
prompts: massive collapse with earth-shaking impact, wall of dust billowing outward
tons of rubble crashing down with a deafening roar, dust cloud engulfing everything

destruction_negative_prompts.description: 破坏效果常见问题——如果像水流/棉花/果冻一样融化，直接打回
prompts: destruction looking like melting or dissolving (不能像融化)
destruction like cotton or soft material (不能像棉花)
instant disappearance without debris (不能瞬间消失)
no visible debris, dust, or fragments (必须有碎片)
